scope: read-only projection estimate over the v4.1 single-class train pool; no images/inference/labels-as-input

calibration.note: formula u=cx-fx*y/x, v=cy-fy*z/x with FLU camera axes

limitations: MS1 width approximated by its axis
upper bound because occlusion would reduce visibility

consequence_if_reused_as_is.same_frame_omission: frames where MS1 is projected visible and a tower bbox is also labelled: class1 exists but is unlabelled -> the two-class trainer treats it as background, directly suppressing the same-frame disambiguation case the gate needs
consequence_if_reused_as_is.background_penalty: frames where MS1 is projected visible without any instance label: class1 gradient pushes 'no MS1 here' on exactly the MS1 views; class1 recall/photometric invariance risk
consequence_if_reused_as_is.quantified_risk: see overall.ratio_8px / ratio_20px; any frame used in two-class training with single-class labels is an unlabelled-MS1 frame
consequence_if_reused_as_is.not_measured: occlusion by terrain/robots and annotation-source mismatch are UNKNOWN; estimate is an upper bound of visible frames

mitigations: pre-register a v4.1 inclusion rule: exclude frames where projected MS1 height >= 20 px (or 8 px if more conservative) from the two-class train pass; report the excluded fraction before training
or annotate class1 in the affected v4.1 frames (same-frame completeness rule) before training; this is the only option that keeps the vulnerable views
do not rely on a pixel/loss ignore mask: ultralytics 8.2.0 pose loss has no per-region ignore mechanism; adding one is a code change with its own risk
keep the new two-class-only families as the primary class1 supervision and report class1 recall on the excluded views separately as a generalization probe (not train signal)
